correctness.rationale: For every \(m\ge2\), the exact closed-neighborhood deletion and vertex deletion are joins of m copies of \(\operatorname{Ind}(P_3)\) and \(\operatorname{Ind}(P_5)\). Explicit collapses give equivariant homology signs +1 and -1 under each path reversal. Their joins are homotopy \(S^{m-1}\) and \(S^{2m-1}\), and their inclusion is null because m-1<2m-1; the mapping cone is \(S^m\) wedge \(S^{2m-1}\). Integral long exact sequences transfer the respective join characters without assuming an equivariant homotopy splitting. The graph automorphism group is exactly \(C_2\wr S_m\) by its unique degree-2m vertex. Standard-library independent-face enumeration confirms full mod-two Betti ranks at m=2,3 and signed Lefschetz predictions for 8+48+72 actions at m=2,3,4. The finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: An infinite, canonical family of graph wedges has two nonzero integral homology groups with sharply contrasting full automorphism-group characters: all local reflections affect one degree, all petal transpositions affect the other. This solves a natural group-action refinement of prior graph-wedge topology and shows that no positive-degree rational class survives the full quotient, despite two sphere summands. It is not a parameter-tuned finite example or a bare restatement of standard joins; the vertex cofiber and group-action comparison are necessary.
